name: Caffeinate
description: Keep the Mac awake with the power assertions `caffeinate -dimsu` takes: `caffeinate on [--minutes=N]`, `caffeinate off`, `caffeinate toggle [--minutes=N]` and `caffeinate status`, with a `state` status segment that reads `on` while the hold lasts.

commands.description: Keep the Mac awake, for --minutes or until caffeinate off

args.description: How long to keep the Mac awake
